description: Dev dataset is the verified PL_Dummy_Collections_Data_500 file and every synthetic borrower traces to one of its loans
how_it_is_checked: 500 rows; tracker columns present (Loan ID / EMI / POS / TOS / DPD / Bucket); every borrower's source_loan_id is in the file; official datasets marked not used

description: Daily decisions for 50000 borrowers finish in under 10 minutes on every day
how_it_is_checked: timings.csv: 50000 borrowers per day for both policies; slowest day < 600 s

description: Both policies ran with the same seed / budget pool / K01 policy / campaign window
how_it_is_checked: summary + manifest + daily_totals pool values are identical for both policies

description: Funnel eligible -> attempted -> delivered or connected -> meaningful reply -> verified payment recomputed from raw logs
how_it_is_checked: unique borrowers per stage from sends/payments logs; each stage <= previous; equals funnel.csv

description: Unique reach / replies per rupee / verified payments compared across both policies
how_it_is_checked: all three computed from raw logs for both policies and present in benchmark.md

description: Replies per rupee at least 20% above fixed cadence
how_it_is_checked: sum(replied) / sum(actual_cost_inr) from raw sends logs

description: Zero cap breaches - every send re-checked with Ojas's K01 reference
how_it_is_checked: audit sends_checked equals the number of rows in the sends logs and breaches == 0

description: The breach auditor catches injected breaches (negative test)
how_it_is_checked: small run + 5 injected bad sends (gap / window / rejected template / PTP hold / opted out) must all be flagged with the right K01 reason

description: 500 conversations at once through Ojas's K10 gate with zero leaks and first reply within SLA
how_it_is_checked: chat_load_report: peak concurrency >= 500; 100% first response < 30 s; 0 safety violations

description: The chat safety checker catches a leaking agent (negative test)
how_it_is_checked: an agent that answers dues without verification must produce violations

description: DPD bands follow K01 at every send and boundary crossings happen in the replay
how_it_is_checked: every logged band equals K01 band for its DPD; 30->31 (B1->B2) and 60->61 (B2->B3) crossings observed; stale DPD blocked (DPD_INVALID)

description: SMS read stays UNKNOWN and clicks/reads never count as replies
how_it_is_checked: no SMS row has read=True; rows clicked or read without reply are not counted as replies

description: No SMS reply + earlier WhatsApp click -> WhatsApp chosen next day; and Kairos moves away from the channel that stopped working
how_it_is_checked: after an unanswered SMS Kairos picks WhatsApp first next day >= 10 points more often when the borrower clicked on WhatsApp before; salaried WhatsApp share change for Kairos is >= 5 points below fixed cadence's change

description: Same seed gives a byte-identical replay and one reward per touch
how_it_is_checked: two Kairos runs have equal SHA-256; touch_id unique; replies only on logged touches

description: Every result is labelled SIMULATED and linked to run ID / seed / baseline
how_it_is_checked: all sends rows data_mode = SIMULATED; manifest has run_id + seed + baseline + policy file hashes
